poetryFrame.leftVertical: WE ARE YOUNG AND WE ARE RECKLESS TONIGHT; A NIGHT OF MAGIC, MADNESS, AND SIN.
poetryFrame.rightVertical: THE GAME IS HIGH STAKES: FOREVER OR DOWN IN FLAMES? TELL ME WHEN IT ENDS.
poetryFrame.bottomLine: LOVE IS THE MOST BEAUTIFUL KIND OF TORTURE
sonnetLines: Whispers echo through the velvet hall,
A dangerous promise on every breath;
We dance where shadows start to fall,
The game requires a reckless hand,
To build a myth from fragile, pretty lies;
A brilliant chaos meets expectant eyes.
You are the void I learn to fill at last,
With painted lips and skies of crystal hue;
A memory too beautiful to cast,
Forever bound by me, my love, my view.
We burn so bright beneath the midnight stain,
And write your name where nothing was in vain.
